name: Robert Ridge to Lake Angelus
why: Along an open ridge above Lake Rotoiti to a hut on the shore of an alpine tarn at 1,650 m.
book: Angelus Hut (28 bunks) and its campsite must be booked all year round; no cookers in the hut. Mt Robert car park is 7 km from St Arnaud by SH63 and Mount Robert Road.
water: None on the ridge: carry all of it. Untreated tap water at the hut.
dangers: Robert Ridge is exposed to high wind and poor visibility at any time of year.
Sharp, rocky sections after Julius Summit: accidents have happened there in ice.
Snow and ice possible May to December; avalanches in winter.
turnaround: If wind or cloud is bad at the top of the Pinchgut Track, go back down: the ridge has no shelter.

points.name: Mount Robert car park
points.note: End of Mount Robert Road. The Pinchgut Track zigzags up to the bushline.

points.name: Robert Ridge, Julius Summit
points.note: 1,794 m on the pole-marked ridge, with Lake Rotoiti below.

points.name: Angelus Hut
points.note: On Lake Angelus at 1,650 m. Sleep here and return the same way the next day.
